description: Canonical machine-readable composition matrix. One entry per form advertised in byoai/MENU.md. Supported devices are NOT duplicated here: they are resolved from each entry snippet's Seen-on rows, which remain the single source of device applicability. Validated by the private build tooling (composition-validate).

statusVocabulary.supported: Every entry snippet resolves and the form composes for at least one device.
statusVocabulary.incomplete: Advertised but not yet resolvable to a unique entry snippet set; reason required.
statusVocabulary.intentionally-unsupported: Advertised as out of scope for this JVD; reason required.

identityVariables.description: Correlated names: the reference and the definition bind the same value within one service, so they resolve by symbolic equality.

roleBindings.description: Slots, not identities. A role parameter names a position to be filled by a selected construct, so it can never be resolved by symbolic equality. Keyed by construct (kind:name) because one spelling can be an identity in one kind and a role in another: policy-statement:$INSTANCE_NAME is correlated, community:$INSTANCE_NAME is not.

bindings.rationale: The reference spells the per-service L3VPN route-target community as $INSTANCE_NAME (for example METRO_L3VPN_2002); the definition spells the same construct METRO_L3VPN_$L3VPN_ID. One construct, two spellings — not a missing definition.

Every device that runs only L2 services binds exactly this one policy body: an1_mx204, ma1-1_acx7024, ma1-2_acx7024 and ma5_mx204 each resolve to a single provider across every vrf-export on the device.

Service tier, and the operator must state it. Gold is the more common binding but it is not a default: bronze is validated on an3_acx7100-48l, ma1-1_acx7024, ma1-2_acx7024, meg1_acx7100-32c and meg2_acx7509, and the two steer onto different transport classes.

Every PE-CE VRF on every device this family reaches binds this one import policy: 200 on an3_acx7100-48l, 200 on ma3_acx7100-48l, 2999 on ma4_mx204, 3299 on mse1_mx304 and 3299 on mse2_mx304, with no other body observed.
Every IP-prefix VRF binds this one import policy: 50 instances each on an3_acx7100-48l, mse1_mx304 and mse2_mx304, with no other body observed.

Both devices this family reaches bind this one export policy for their IP-prefix VRFs: 50 instances on an3_acx7100-48l and 50 on mse1_mx304. mse2_mx304 uses the RT-5 NLRI form instead, but no supported form reaches it for this family.

The export policy carries the customer prefixes, so the choice is a service parameter the operator must state: address family, how many CE prefixes the VRF advertises, and whether the routes are coloured. All forms are validated in the JVD and none is a default — ma4_mx204 alone splits 999 coloured v4 against 1000 v6.

forms.note: 2-UNI and 3-UNI forms and the vlan-aware forms exist as separate snippets; only the 4-UNI form is declared here until the UNI-count dimension is modelled.

an3_acx7100-48l and ma5_mx204 each contain 201 L2VPN instances across five structural forms: one port-based, 51 VLAN, 49 VLAN with control-word, 50 VLAN with export policy, and 50 VLAN with both control-word and export policy. This advertised port-based template matches one instance on each device. The additional junos/routing-instances/l2vpn/ri-l2vpn-kompella.conf representation covers that same MA5 instance plus a root group-application statement; it is not a second population of services and is not an additional advertised entry.
LDP-signalled: carries no BGP overlay requirement. Hub-side forms are separate snippets.
